name: chain_event_render
summary: Takes a normalized chain event (program_id, category, action, signature, ts) and renders an image (synchronous via ComfyUI MCP) and/or queues a video (HunyuanVideo via MediaLab — queue file only in v0). Two trigger paths converge here: (a) PUSH from studio/endpoints/webhook/solana_webhook.py when Helius/Triton fires, (b) PULL from tail_loop() watching ~/.cc/program_events/**/*.jsonl. Same event always produces the same prompt + seed → deterministic. Graceful degradation: if ComfyUI is not on :8188, image_status='queued_offline' and the manifest is still written so work resumes when comfy is up.
engine_pattern: Stdlib + ComfyUIMCPConnector. Per (category, action) → archetype prompt template (15 templates locked, covering the main DEX/perps/lending/NFT/casino/MEV/memecoin archetypes). Per-event variation injected via 'sigil_seed' tail (first 8 chars of signature) — same archetype, different concrete render. Seed for the diffusion sampler is SHA-256(signature+ts) truncated to 32 bits.

files: image.png    — rendered image (only if ComfyUI was reachable)
video.mp4    — placeholder; video path appends to ~/.cc/chain_renders/_video_queue.jsonl
